transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this pre-run gate meeting for the urgent bracket order. As we know, the refurbished stamping die D-18 is available and Press 2 is currently listed as the planned machine. Before I make the go/no-go call and record the production authorization, I need maintenance and quality engineering to state any unresolved technical or release conditions. I also want to note that Press 5 is idle through the end of the week if we determine a reassignment is warranted and tooling and release requirements are satisfied. Let's hear from maintenance and quality first.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical condition. The refurbishment shop's fit report, which I received by email yesterday but haven't yet entered in the maintenance work order, shows that D-18's lower shoe is incompatible with Press 2 due to a 0.25 mm bolster mismatch. The die is only compatible with Press 5. Additionally, installing the replacement guide-post set on Press 5 requires exactly 6 hours.

transcript.text: I have a release condition to flag.
